lede: Wat Yuan accounts for 42 catalogued manuscripts, 22 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phayao (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (98%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (88%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (12%). Dated witnesses run 1910–1935 CE (5 of 42 carry a date).
